text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before training, Gold City is getting an interview for a magazine.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What I'm into? Well, I recently started practicing yoga. I happen to know a good teacher.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see. Just as expected, you're mindful of maintaining your physique!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Um… It's more for relaxation and strengthening my core.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, of course. With the amount of training you do, I'm sure you don't have any trouble keeping in shape!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That was too close. I would've been done for if I told him the yoga was to complement my diet.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, you know… when I'm hanging out with people like Jordan, I tend to overeat a little.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ugh, this is embarrassing. I'll have reached my goal soon, so don't tell anyone about the diet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, and perhaps thanks to the benefits of doing yoga, Gold City regains her usual physique.
